title: design-lab run scorecard
description: Written by scripts/score_run.ts. Each section is scored on its own; a section without evidence carries status not-measured and a reason instead of a guess.

buildCreatedAt.$comment: project.json createdAt of the build scored; a reader compares it with the current project.json to tell this build's scorecard from an earlier one's

clock.$comment: wall time, a clock on the wall from workflow.ts init to the end of the benchmark; null unless both ends were recorded; the first scoring records the benchmark's end in the phase log

working.$comment: time Claude or its tools were working, from the session transcript; working plus the three kinds of waiting add up to the transcript's span

unattended.$comment: whether the run stayed unattended after the preflight go-ahead, until the benchmark began

coverage.$comment: built out of what could have been built, gap by reason, usage-weighted share

accuracy.$comment: accuracy against the live site: original metric kept beside the corrected one

schemaChurn.$comment: did the run need a schema change or workaround

foundationsVoice.$comment: slot for the foundations-and-voice rubric, scored by a person later

blindedJudgement.$comment: slot for blinded visual judgement, 1 to 5 per criterion, scored later
